milestone: M6 successor #2561 — make Done.facts whole-set GraphQL reads complete

findings.summary: The receiver-visible done-stamp behavior change was presented as non-packaged work, leaving the coherent 0.56.0 release, source-ahead-of-feed registry state, and architecture-map disposition unrecorded.
evidence: Verification: at initial reviewed commit e7d25700f83070780524e996932331d7970811ec, Directory.Build.props still declared FsggCoherentSetVersion 0.55.0 even though src/FS.GG.Coord.GitHub/Done.fs changed the behavior consumed by the packed FS.GG.Coord.Cli tool.

Verification: the live PR #2619 body read through `gh pr view 2619 --repo FS-GG/.github --json headRefOid,body,url` stated `No package release is owed: FS.GG.Coord.GitHub.fsproj is explicitly non-packable`, named no post-merge coherent-set release, and carried neither an `architecture-map: unaffected` line nor that opt-out label.

Verification: `.agents/skills/publishing-and-deployment/SKILL.md` requires the coherent FS.GG.Kit/FS.GG.Drivers/FS.GG.Coord.Cli set to move and publish together, records source-ahead-of-feed state before publication, and requires an explicit architecture-map opt-out when a routine registry version move does not alter system shape.
resolution_evidence: Verification: repair commit 657e81021c636cfb82dae241b4a7e71fdb29ddd8 advances FsggCoherentSetVersion and all three evaluated package versions to stable 0.56.0, bounds current FS.GG.Coord.Cli PackageReleaseNotes, advances registry coord-engine source while retaining package-version 0.55.0, updates the compatibility projection, and prepends the dated registry changelog entry.

Verification: `bash tests/coherent-set-version/run.sh && python3 scripts/check-coherent-set-version.py` passed 13/13 fixture assertions and resolved all three package projects to 0.56.0; `bash tests/engine-release-notes/run.sh && python3 scripts/check-engine-release-notes.py` passed 25/25 fixture assertions and measured 4422/35000 release-note characters.

Verification: `fsgg-sdd registry validate registry/dependencies.yml --text`, the 27/27 projection fixture plus live projection checker, the 28/28 registry-changelog fixture plus live checker, and the live dual-feed coherence check all passed; the live feed check confirmed coord-engine package-version 0.55.0 equals both feeds during the publish-before-flip window.

Verification: independent `dotnet pack` runs produced FS.GG.Kit.0.56.0.nupkg, FS.GG.Drivers.0.56.0.nupkg, and FS.GG.Coord.Cli.0.56.0.nupkg; nuspec inspection confirmed all three versions and the CLI's current 0.56.0 release narrative.

Verification: `gh pr view 2619 --repo FS-GG/.github --json headRefOid,body,url,state,title,labels,mergeable,statusCheckRollup` after repair reports exact head 657e81021c636cfb82dae241b4a7e71fdb29ddd8, a standalone `architecture-map: unaffected` line, the content-addressed GitHub-first/NuGet-second 0.56.0 post-merge obligation, the 0.55.0-until-verified registry rule, and no false `No package release is owed` claim; the architecture-map check had already completed successfully.

findings.summary: The 0.56.0 source-version move left three canonical generated release/version projections at 0.55.0, making the projection and semantic skill-quality gates fail.
evidence: Verification: at prior confirmed head 657e81021c636cfb82dae241b4a7e71fdb29ddd8, the generated release-inventory rows in `.agents/skills/publishing-and-deployment/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/publishing-and-deployment/SKILL.md` each still recorded coord-engine source version 0.55.0, and the generated `fsgg-versions` row in docs/architecture.md also recorded source 0.55.0, while registry/dependencies.yml declared source 0.56.0.

Verification: `git diff --name-status 657e81021c636cfb82dae241b4a7e71fdb29ddd8..3861b4d5e23165ba9e4dba6c4345d76a12d69ea5` identifies the two publishing skill mirrors and docs/architecture.md as the generated projection repairs, alongside the previously reviewed critique artifact update.
resolution_evidence: Verification: repair commit 3861b4d5e23165ba9e4dba6c4345d76a12d69ea5 changes only the coord-engine source-version cell from 0.55.0 to 0.56.0 in each of the three generated regions; published/package version and coherent-set identity remain correctly at verified 0.55.0, and no architecture topology prose or edge changes.
Verification: `bash scripts/generate-projections --check` at 3861b4d5e23165ba9e4dba6c4345d76a12d69ea5 returned `projections: current`; the component-count fixture passed 6/6.
Verification: `bash tests/skill-quality/run.sh` at 3861b4d5e23165ba9e4dba6c4345d76a12d69ea5 completed successfully, including `skill-quality: OK`, current projections, and all 46 rejection cases.

Verification: final-head live checks remain green: FS.GG.Coord.GitHub.Tests passed 613/613; coherent-set projects resolve to 0.56.0; release notes measure 4422/35000 characters; typed registry validation reports 0 diagnostics; registry compatibility projection passes; and both feeds still equal retained package-version 0.55.0.

findings.summary: Regenerating the publishing skill's 0.56.0 release inventory left its canonical driver-skill manifest integrity fields bound to the previous bytes, failing registry coherence.
evidence: Verification: at prior reviewed head 3861b4d5e23165ba9e4dba6c4345d76a12d69ea5, registry/driver-skill-manifest.json recorded publishing-and-deployment SKILL.md/file SHA-256 `07a387522fb64300075273220c91c32c606873720972289efbd9ead20306900b` and tree SHA-256 `e5dc3b5caa52a303b7bf60e931fc9042d5107b6f776bbebe7cf3af1516fa5a02`, while the regenerated `.claude/skills/publishing-and-deployment/SKILL.md` bytes hash to `8ed210977728e60d50438bc5c6d9b9e9c92ce8c0c2c58131627de4cc9c757227`.

Verification: `git diff --unified=40 3861b4d5e23165ba9e4dba6c4345d76a12d69ea5..5c720426993472921e5968b09cdbe46070446ccc -- registry/driver-skill-manifest.json` shows the stale content/file/tree integrity fields as the only manifest values requiring repair.
resolution_evidence: Verification: repair commit 5c720426993472921e5968b09cdbe46070446ccc updates only publishing-and-deployment's manifest content/file SHA-256 to `8ed210977728e60d50438bc5c6d9b9e9c92ce8c0c2c58131627de4cc9c757227` and tree SHA-256 to `596a9b9b1d5a98ac13dc28f098220e99b93710475404879ed04178ce2a4a5463`; scope, supplied-by, materialization policy, agent file hash, and every other manifest row remain unchanged.

Verification: independent SHA-256 computation over `.claude/skills/publishing-and-deployment/SKILL.md` equals the repaired manifest content/file hash `8ed210977728e60d50438bc5c6d9b9e9c92ce8c0c2c58131627de4cc9c757227`.

Verification: `python3 scripts/generate-driver-manifest --check` reports both driver and coordination-kit manifests current; `bash scripts/generate-projections --check` reports current; `bash tests/skill-quality/run.sh` passes semantic checks and all 46 rejection cases.

Verification: final-head regression gates remain green: FS.GG.Coord.GitHub.Tests passed 613/613; coherent-set projects resolve to 0.56.0; release notes measure 4422/35000 characters; typed registry validation reports 0 diagnostics; and registry compatibility projection passes.
